title: Israel's Repentance and Preparation Against the Ammonites
description: Israel falls into idolatry and is oppressed by the Philistines and Ammonites for eighteen years. When they cry out to the Lord, He first rejects them and tells them to cry out to the gods they have chosen. After removing the foreign gods and serving the Lord, the Israelites gather at Mizpah against the Ammonites who have camped in Gilead, and the leaders of Gilead seek a commander to lead the battle.
